why: Done: the local branch is deleted ('Deleted branch update-name'), and the remote one is already gone: GitHub deleted the head branch when the PR merged, so `git push --delete` says 'remote ref does not exist'. `git fetch --prune` drops the stale origin/update-name and `git branch -a` lists no update-name anywhere.

Terminal: tripi@mac gitgoing % git push --delete origin update-name
error: unable to delete 'update-name': remote ref does not exist
error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/ada-learner/GitGoing.git'
